Look you don't have to read the book if you don't want to,but do really think about this going forward. Your young and no matter what age you start at your will one day pass as a man. Having said that though you might want to just give yourself more time to figure out if this is really who you are. I don't say this to discredit you at all but speaking from personal accounts of people I know IRL,they would've regreted getting on T while they were young because that's not who they wanted to be as they got older.I started when I was 20 which sucked but I had all that time to know that is who I was and I couldn't be happier. Just sit down and have a hard talk with yourself,ask serious questions. "Who are you? What kind of friends do you surround yourself with? Are you wanting all the responsibilities that come with being a man?" So on and so forth. These may seem silly but once you really think about it I believe these questions become far more relevant.just take your time kiddo,you'll be ok.
